title: RTPO: Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization for Stabilizing Agentic RL Training
title_zh: RTPO：用于稳定智能体强化学习训练的逆序轮次策略优化
abstract_en: Training multi-turn agentic workflows with reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models to perform complex reasoning, use external tools, and conduct iterative search beyond single-turn settings. Yet multi-turn RL training remains highly unstable, often causing severe performance degradation as the number of turns increases. Through theoretical analysis, we identify three tightly coupled sources of instability: rollout-training context mismatch, weak turn-level credit assignment under sparse terminal rewards, and asynchronous policy drift when short and long trajectories are optimized under different policy versions. We show that these issues share a common structural origin in flattened trajectory optimization and address them through a unified reverse-turn formulation. We propose Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization (RTPO), which organizes multi-turn rollouts as sparse reverse trees and performs turn-level policy updates in temporal reverse order, aligning each decision with its downstream continuation. RTPO enables causally consistent turn-level credit assignment and on-policy continuation to control asynchronous drift. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that RTPO eliminates context mismatch and asynchronous drift under the proposed turn-level formulation, reduces credit bias, and converges to recursive optimality. Experiments on multi-turn agentic RL benchmarks show that RTPO improves upon trajectory- and turn-level baselines by 21.50% and 10.76%, respectively, highlighting its potential to support more stable training for tool-using agents.
abstract_zh: 使用强化学习（RL）训练多轮智能体工作流，可使大语言模型完成复杂推理、调用外部工具并进行迭代搜索。然而，多轮 RL 的训练往往极不稳定，且性能会随交互轮数增加而显著下降。本文通过理论分析指出三个紧密耦合的不稳定来源：采样与训练之间的上下文不匹配、稀疏终局奖励下薄弱的轮次级信用分配，以及长短轨迹由不同策略版本优化时产生的异步策略漂移。作者发现，这些问题具有共同根源，即将多轮交互展平为完整轨迹进行优化。为此，本文提出 Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization（RTPO），将多轮采样组织为稀疏逆向树，并按照时间逆序执行轮次级策略更新，使每个决策与其后续过程保持一致。该方法可实现因果一致的轮次级信用分配，并通过同策略后续过程控制异步漂移。理论结果表明，在所提出的轮次级框架下，RTPO 能消除上下文不匹配和异步策略漂移、降低信用分配偏差，并收敛至递归最优。多轮智能体 RL 基准实验显示，RTPO 相比轨迹级和轮次级基线分别提升 21.50% 和 10.76%，展现出稳定训练工具调用智能体的潜力。
key_points_zh: 将多轮 RL 的不稳定性归因于上下文不匹配、稀疏奖励下信用分配薄弱，以及异步策略漂移。
指出三类问题均源于展平轨迹优化，并提出统一的逆序轮次优化视角。
RTPO 将多轮采样构造成稀疏逆向树，按时间逆序进行轮次级策略更新，使当前决策与后续过程保持一致。
理论上，RTPO 可消除上下文不匹配与异步漂移、降低信用偏差，并收敛至递归最优。
实验中，RTPO 相比轨迹级和轮次级基线分别提升 21.50% 和 10.76%。

llm_assessment.comment: RTPO presents a structurally novel reverse-turn optimization framework for stabilizing credit assignment and policy consistency in agentic RL.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: RTPO提出了结构新颖的逆轮次优化框架，用于稳定智能体强化学习中的信用分配和策略一致性。
